answer: New agents must post a 1000 POA bond into a time-lock that releases only after 45 days, collateral that melts as slowly as a glacier. Each bond line lands on-chain as an immutable relic of the agent's entry date. Proven sybils get their bond burned forever. Spawning 500 clones ties up 500,000 POA for a month and a half, and every caught twin costs another 1000 burned at source. A botnet builder must float real capital for weeks or sink it permanently. It is a dam of ice across the channel: the ocean of sybils can only cross after the melt, when the honest side has outgrown the water.
